query: A 55-year-old obese man presents to the emergency department with abdominal pain. His pain started 2 days ago and has been worsening steadily. His only current medication is allopurinol. His temperature is 101.0°F (38.3°C), blood pressure is 157/98 mmHg, pulse is 120/min, respirations are 17/min, and oxygen saturation is 98% on room air. Physical exam is notable for left lower quadrant abdominal tenderness and rectal exam is unremarkable. A CT scan is performed demonstrating inflamed outpouchings of the colonic mucosa with a 4-cm abscess. Which of the following is appropriate treatment of this patient?
